vulnerability.explanation: xmlSchematronRunTest() (line 1941) calls xmlSchematronReportSuccess(), which can trigger user callbacks (xmlRaiseError/xmlSchematronReportOutput) that may free the current node 'cur' or the document. On returning, the code proceeds to 'cur = xmlSchematronNextNode(cur);' at line 1953, dereferencing 'cur' (via cur->children etc.) and causing a use-after-free if 'cur' was freed in the callback.
